scope: Renderer services for authored SDK projects, independent camera/model/texture/material previews, complete viewport modes/controls and actual Play/Simulate handoff to the game logic owner.
limitations: Reference source/document behavior is used under the SDK-0 fallback; fresh original-binary parity is not claimed.

Runtime executes the currently restored model/light object kinds. Unresolved dependencies and unsupported domain kinds reject Play; their authoring/runtime modules remain in their planned domain stages.
Shader complexity counts SPIR-V function instructions; geometry complexity estimates triangles per projected bounds area. Neither is a hardware timing counter.
In-process production WinForms mouse/key handlers and WM_DPICHANGED are exercised on hidden HWNDs; physical desktop/manual or physical monitor migration is not claimed.
Performance evidence is 64 CPU transform submissions with zero new scene/model cooks; it is not a large-level frame-time acceptance profile.
